title: Digital Transformation for a Construction Company
excerpt: How we helped MP Bau modernize their online presence with a high-performance website and project management tools.
challenge: MP Bau, a growing construction firm, relied on an outdated website that failed to reflect their professional standards. The site was slow, not mobile-friendly, and lacked any way for potential clients to request quotes or view completed projects. They were losing leads to competitors with stronger digital presence.
solution: We built a modern, blazing-fast website using Next.js with server-side rendering for optimal SEO performance. The site features a dynamic project gallery showcasing completed builds, an integrated quote request form, and a content management system so the MP Bau team can update projects independently. We also implemented structured data markup to improve search visibility for local construction queries.
results: Page load time reduced from 8s to under 1s
Mobile-responsive design increased mobile traffic by 60%
Quote requests through the website increased 3x within the first month
First-page Google ranking for key local construction terms

testimonial.quote: webvise transformed our digital presence completely. The new website not only looks professional but actually generates leads for us. We went from zero online inquiries to multiple quote requests per week.
testimonial.author: M. Petersen
